_comment: Which pages the route pass visits (tests/linux/studio-crawl.sh, crawl.mjs). The pages come from the Studio artifact's routes-manifest.json; this file says where each parameter's values come from (the fixtures seed.mjs makes), which pages are not visited and why, and which pages sit behind a hidden feature key (they are visited in the informational pass: their findings are listed and do not fail the run). A page with a parameter and no values is a failure of the run ("no fixture"), so a new Studio page cannot go unvisited without a line here.

states._comment: Extra visits for the branch states the fixtures make: the project home and the Branches page of each.
